title: 第7章 女主逆推却之不恭第8章 收服风云韵林萧毁了紫云矿脉
lines: 见自己心防大开，风云韵只觉羞赧无比。
但是很快她就注意到了，自己身上的伤势好像已经完全修复。
那狮王猛烈的一击竟然没能留下半点伤口。
光滑雪嫩的肌肤白皙的如同婴儿一般，这让她重新看向面前的年轻人，心中不知道做何感想。
剑眉星目，气宇轩昂。
嘴角含笑，又给人一种亲近之感。
加上无上魅力光环加成，风云韵一下子就生出好感，胸口不断上下起伏，仿佛在不争气的宣告她的心意即将喷涌而出。
“可恶……怎么回事？难道是魅术？”
风云韵心中大骇，她根本就没想过自己竟然会对一个陌生的年轻少年心动。
“多谢你救了我！”见顾云不回话，她强撑着坐起身子。
“对不起……你能不能转过身去。”她俏脸微微一红，自知有些不妥，就开口问道。
顾云照做，转过身去。
可是风云韵身上的力气全无，连换衣服都做不到。
她只好娇羞开口：“对……对不起，我……我好像还是没什么力气。”
“能不能……麻烦你帮我换一下衣服。”
顾云转过身，淡淡道：“你这是将我当成呼之即来，挥之即去的佣人了？”
“没……没有。”风云韵看着顾云那充满侵略的眼神，直呼遭不住，娇躯微微的颤动。
忽地。
一道电流自她的心尖穿过。
“这就是心动的感觉吗？”
风云韵几乎不敢与顾云对视，只能偏过头去。
顾云伸出手，将她的脑袋掰了回来：“我救了你，还好心帮你治好了伤势，可是到现在却连一声谢谢都没有听到。”
“你觉得会不会有些没有礼貌？”
“谢、谢。”风云韵眼眸颤抖。
顾云淡然一笑。
伸出手，一套衣裙显现于侧，其上神华闪烁，风云韵直接就看呆了。
这是什么级别的宝器？
六阶？
还是传说中的七阶？
若是顾云知晓其内心想法，只能冷笑一声，他手中的哪会是那般低劣的货色，这可都是道身境穿着的十阶法袍，就算是化龙境强者的攻击都能阻挡。
content_en:
"Who...are you?"
Seeing that her guard was wide open, Feng Yunyun felt extremely embarrassed.
But soon she noticed that her injuries seemed to have been completely repaired.
The lion king's fierce blow did not leave any wounds.
Her smooth and tender skin was as white as a baby's, which made her look at the young man in front of her again, not knowing what to think.
Sword eyebrows and starry eyes, majestic and majestic.
The smile at the corner of his mouth gives people a sense of intimacy.
Coupled with the bonus of the supreme charm aura, Feng Yunyun immediately developed a good impression, and her chest kept rising and falling, as if she was announcing that her heart was about to burst out.
"Damn...what's going on? Is it a charm?"
Feng Yunyun was shocked. She never thought that she would be attracted to a strange young boy.
"Thank you for saving me!" Seeing that Gu Yun didn't reply, she forced herself to sit up.
"I'm sorry...can you turn around?" Her pretty face blushed slightly, and she knew something was wrong, so she asked.
Gu Yun did as he was told and turned around.
But Feng Yunyun had no strength at all and couldn't even change her clothes.
She could only say shyly: "Yes... I'm sorry, I... I still don't seem to have enough strength."
"Can...please help me change my clothes."
Gu Yun turned around and said calmly: "Do you think of me as a servant who comes and goes at a moment's notice?"
"No...no." Feng Yunyun looked at Gu Yun's eyes full of aggression and said that she couldn't stand it, and her delicate body trembled slightly.
Suddenly.
An electric current passed through her heart.
"Is this what heartbeat feels like?"
Feng Yunyun almost didn't dare to look at Gu Yun, so she could only turn her head.
Gu Yun stretched out his hand and pulled her head back: "I saved you, and I was kind enough to help you heal your injuries, but until now I haven't even heard a word of thanks."
"Do you think it would be a little rude?"
"Thank you, thank you." Feng Yunyun's eyes trembled.
Gu Yun smiled lightly.
Stretching out his hand, a set of clothes appeared on the side, with divine flowers flashing on them, and Fengyun Yun was immediately stunned.
What level of treasure is this?
Sixth level?
Or the legendary seventh level?
If Gu Yun knew what he was thinking, he could only sneer. What he had in his hands could not be such inferior goods. These were all tenth-level robes worn by Taoist realm, and they could block even the attacks of strong men in the Dragon Transformation realm.
title_en: Chapter 7 The heroine's disrespectful rejection Chapter 8 Conquering Fengyun Yun Lin Xiao destroyed the Ziyun Mine
